thread:
zane: just finished a focused sweep across us-east1 / eu-west1 / us-central comparing A10G, L4, and T4 for embeddings and a low-latency chat profile. sharing highlights + raw numbers below.
bench-bot: run 2026-03-18T14:02Z (config attached to run id)
zane: setup: model=redwood-small-v1 (~7B), quants tested=[fp16,q8_0,q3_k], kernels tested=[fused_v3, fused_v2, split-attn], emb_batch=128, chat_batch=4, seq_len_emb=128, seq_len_chat=256
zane: embeddings p50/p95 (ms) @batch128: A10G 16/22, L4 24/34, T4 21/28
zane: embeddings cosine delta vs fp16 baseline: q8_0 -0.0009, q3_k -0.0150; recall@10: fp16 0.845, q8_0 0.843, q3_k 0.812
maria: q3_k drop looks a bit big for recall. is that uniform across corpus or tail queries?
zane: mostly tail; hard negatives and long-context queries degrade more. we'll add stratified eval.
alex: chat throughput (tokens/s) and p95 for batch=4?
zane: chat batch4 throughput (tokens/s): A10G 30k, L4 17k, T4 14k. p95 latency (ms) chat: A10G 110, L4 210, T4 150
jess: interesting that T4 p95 is between A10G and L4. which kernel was active for that run?
zane: eu-west T4 fleet used fused_v2; A10G runs used fused_v3 which gave best p95. L4 runs in us-central were on split-attn by default.
sam: any cost estimates normalized to $/1M tokens (hosted spot equiv)?
zane: rough regional-normalized numbers: A10G $6.0, L4 $3.0, T4 $2.7 (note: eu-west T4 pricing is lower in our billing; see billing link)
maria: can you paste short quality check for chat with q3_k and q8_0 vs fp16? automated + small human pass?
zane: automated metric delta (BLEU-like): q8_0 -0.4%, q3_k -1.7%. human review (50 prompts): q8_0 minor issues ~2/50, q3_k more truncated answers ~6/50. recommendation: q3_k not safe for low-temp conversational paths; q8_0 OK with monitoring.
bench-bot: sample command run
bench-bot: ```
./sweep_runner --model redwood-small-v1 --gpus A10G,T4,L4 --quant fp16,q8_0,q3_k --kernels fused_v3,fused_v2,split-attn --regions us-east1,eu-west1,us-central1 --workloads embeddings,small-chat --out results/1772104321
```
alex: capacity planning: assume steady 100 qps small-chat (avg tokens/request=100). how many GPUs per region?
zane: calc: tokens/s = 100 * 100 = 10k tokens/s. observed throughput (batch4): A10G 30k => 0.33 GPUs, L4 17k => 0.59, T4 14k => 0.71. guidance: for 99.9% SLA prefer headroom -> A10G: 1 primary + 1 warm standby; L4: 2 primaries (or 1 primary + 1 warm standby if you accept modest risk); T4: 2 nodes recommended.
jess: note: eu-west T4 fleet missing fused_v3; p95 there was ~+9% vs A10G fused_v3. filed runtime rollout ticket.
zane: added ENGML-389 (long seq rerun 1024), ENGML-390 (quant library sweep q4 variants), ENGML-391 (cold vs warm KV cache bench). assigning to @alex and @jess.
maria: next steps for product sizing: 1) rerun for seq_len=1024 (edge cases), 2) add q4 and a different q8 lib, 3) capture cold-start latencies and warmed KV cache delta, 4) collect per-region billing confirmed by infra.
infra-bot: billed-region confirmation requested, ticket BILL-933 opened
